style: a cinematic, photoreal night-time automotive commercial shot, high contrast, deep near-black shadows with orange rim light, no text, no logos
setting: a giant curved concrete loop track at night high above a valley of city lights

subjects.desc: a sleek unbranded low two-seat electric hypercar, dark grey with orange rim light, no badges or text

shots.camera: The camera tracks smoothly alongside the car at a medium speed.
shots.action: The car drives upside down along the inside ceiling of the loop, held firmly against the concrete; thin white air streaks are pulled from under its body; the orange track lights streak past.

soundscape: A deep electric motor whine and a strong rushing wind, echoing off the concrete track.
